subject: Help wanted: Spanish language users of Distance 3.5

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Help wanted: Spanish language users of Distance 3.5
parts:
This message is for spanish language users of Distance 3.5.

If you are successfully running Distance 3.5 in a Spanish language version of
Windows 95 or 98 please can you send me a copy of a project file that you have
used in Distance? It will help me diagnose a problem that some people are
having with Distance. Please make sure that:

1. You are using a Spanish language version of Windows - not an English
Language version with Spanish regional settings. You'll know if its the right
version if your start menu is called "Inicio" and your windows help ("Ayunda de
Windows") is in Spanish.

2. You have opened the distance project file and, say run at least one
analysis. (You can use the sample files if you like)

3. You zip the project file up using Winzip or equivalent if possible before
you send it to me, so it's not too large. Please tell me which version of
windows you're using.

Thanks!

- Len Thomas



--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland KY16 9SS

email: dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk
RUWPA home page: http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk
